rationale:
Positives: The agent properly authenticated the user via full name + zip, identified the correct order and item, asked the user to confirm the exact exchange before performing a write, and used the stored payment method ID tied to the authenticated account.

Failures: After calling the exchange tool, the tool response did not indicate success or provide any pricing info, yet the agent stated the exchange had been processed and quoted a specific refund amount ($60.78) and follow-up email—information not supported by the tool output. Additionally, the agent asserted availability and a specific replacement item ID without clear evidence from the truncated product details. These constitute fabricated/unsupported statements. Given the policy requires correct final information and avoiding invention of facts, this fails the pass bar.
